newsitem.title: HONG KONG: FPB Holdings unit sets dual-currency FRCD.
newsitem.headline: FPB Holdings unit sets dual-currency FRCD.

text.p: The following issue was announced by the arrangers.
BORROWER FIRST PACIFIC BANK LTD
AMOUNT US$35 MLN EQUIVALENT, AVAILABLE IN TWO TRANCHES.
TRANCHE (A) : IN HONG KONG DOLLARS
TRANCHE (B) : IN US DOLLARS
COUPON (A) 3MH+79BP, (B) 3ML+60BP MATURITY 5 YRS
TYPE FRCD ISS PRICE PAR LAUNCH 05.NOV.96
PUTS YR 3 & 4 CALLS YR 3 & 4 REPLIES 22.NOV.96
LISTING NONE REPAYMENT BULLET
DENOMS HK$1 MLN/US$500K
RATING NA SALE LMTS NA TAX PROV STANDARD
NEG PLG YES CRS DEF YES FORCE MAJ IPMA 2
HOME CTRY HONG KONG GOV LAW ENGLISH PAY DATE MID DEC
MGT LEVELS AND FEES TRANCHE/COMMITMENT FEES ALL-IN
CO-LEAD MGRS (A) HK$40 MLN+ 81BP HIBOR+106
(B) US$5 MLN+ 81BP LIBOR+87
SENIOR MANAGERS (A) HK$20-30 MLN 75BP HIBOR+104
(B) US$2-4 MLN 75BP LIBOR+85
ARRANGERS & LEAD MANAGERS CS FIRST BOSTON (HONG KONG) AND
CREDIT LYONNAIS HONG KONG.
CO-ARRANGERS & LEAD MGRS BORAM BANK HONG KONG AND WESTLB
BOOKRUNNERS CREDIT SUISSE (AGENT, NON-ASIAN BOOKS) AND
CREDIT LYONNAIS HONG KONG (ASIAN BOOKS)
NOTES THE ISSUE IS FULLY UNDERWRITTEN BY THE ARRANGERS AND
CO-ARRANGERS. BANKS MAY PARTICIPATE IN BOTH OR EITHER
TRANCHE(S).
*FIRST PACIFIC CO WILL RETAIN AN EFFECTIVE MAJORITY
SHAREHOLDING IN ALL THE ISSUED SHARES OF THE ISSUER,
AND IN ANY EVENT NOT LESS THAN 35 PCT, THROUGHOUT THE
LIFE OF THE FRCDS. FIRST PACIFIC CO LTD WILL RETAIN
CONTROL OF THE ISSUER'S BOARD OF DIRECTORS THROUGHOUT
THE LIFE OF THE FRCDS.
**FIRST PACIFIC BANK IS HELD BY FBP HOLDINGS CO. THE
ULTIMATE CONTROLLING SHAREHOLDER OF FBP HOLDINGS CO IS
FIRST PACIFIC CO, WITH 41.25 PERCENT. A MINORITY STAKE
IS HELD BY MIMET FOTIC INVESTMENT LTD, A JOINT VENTURE
OF THE CHINA TRUST AND INVESTMENT CORP FOR FOREIGN
ECONOMIC RELATIONS AND TRADE (FOTIC) AND CHINA NATIONAL
METALS AND MINERALS IMPORT AND EXPORT CORP (MINMETALS)
REPORTING DIRECTLY TO CHINA'S MINISTRY OF FOREIGN TRADE
AND ECONOMIC COOPERATION (MOFTEC). THE REMAINING 25 PCT
STAKE IS HELD BY THE INVESTING PUBLIC.
--Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
